text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no command-execution tool here. I checked each fix by reading it against the tests, so please run the suite to confirm.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, which matches the lending policy and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the days late instead of multiplying. It now uses `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing "Emma", so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my guess, since the tests only check the titles.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned one event too many (`[-n - 1:]`). It now returns the last `n` events, or an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.
